title: SynDARin: Synthesising Datasets for Automated Reasoning in Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Training and evaluating models (e.g., XLM-RoBERTa) on incomplete inputs (question-only and paragraph-only samples) to detect if the dataset suffers from annotation artifacts or degenerate solutions that can be trivially solved.
Uniformly balancing the correct multiple-choice answers across all possible positions in the dataset to prevent models from exploiting answer ordering.
